name: tenants_add_pay_band
description: Add a pay band for a framework level (level_id, from frameworks_get) in a location: a country, matched to the Org Graph's country ignoring case, or blank for any location. One band per level and location; use tenants_change_pay_band to change one. Currency is an ISO 4217 code and period is year, month or hour; figures are kept as entered, never converted or annualised. Figures are decimal strings with at most two decimal places, such as "120000". Refused unless the caller is a tenant admin.
